an6.61:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
an6.61:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapāta paṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāle sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi:
an6.61:3.1: katamo nu kho āvuso eko anto katamo dutiyo anto, kiṃ majjhe, kā sibbanīti. (1)
an6.61:3.2: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca:
an6.61:3.3: “phasso kho āvuso eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbanī.
an6.61:3.4: taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tasseva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.
an6.61:3.5: ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti. abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassa antakaro hotī’ti. (2)
an6.61:4.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca:
an6.61:4.2: “atītaṃ kho āvuso eko anto, anāgataṃ dutiyo anto, paccuppannaṃ majjhe, taṇhā sibbanī.
an6.61:4.3: taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tasseva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.
an6.61:4.4: ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hotī”ti. (3)
an6.61:5.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca:
an6.61:5.2: “sukhā kho āvuso vedanā eko anto, dukkhā vedanā dutiyo anto, adukkhamasukhā vedanā majjhe, taṇhā sibbanī.
an6.61:5.3: taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tasseva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.
an6.61:5.4: ettāvatā ko āvuso bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti …pe… diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassa antakaro hotī”ti. (4)
an6.61:6.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca:
an6.61:6.2: “nāmaṃ kho āvuso eko anto, rūpaṃ dutiyo anto, viññāṇaṃ majjhe, taṇhā sibbanī.
an6.61:7.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etavoca:
an6.61:7.2: “cha kho āvuso ajjhattikāni āyatanāni eko anto, bāhirāni āyatanāni dutiyo anto, viññāṇaṃ majjhe, taṇhā sibbanī.
an6.61:7.3: taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tasseva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.
an6.61:7.4: ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti …pe… diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassa antakaro hotī”ti. (6)
an6.61:8.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca:
an6.61:8.2: “sakkāyo kho āvuso eko anto, sakkāyasamudayo dutiyo anto, sakkāyanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbanī.
an6.61:8.3: taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tasseva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.
an6.61:8.4: ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti. abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassa antakaro hotī”ti.
an6.61:9.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca:
an6.61:9.2: “byākataṃ kho āvuso amhehi sabbeheva yathāsakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ.
an6.61:9.3: āyāmāvuso, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamissāma, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocessāma,
an6.61:9.4: yathā no bhagavā vyākarissati, tathā naṃ dhāressāmā”ti.
an6.61:10.1: evamāvuso’ti kho therā bhikkhū tassa bhikkhuno paccassosuṃ.
an6.61:10.2: atha kho therā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu,
an6.61:10.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho therā bhikkhū yāvatako ahosi sabbeheva saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesuṃ:
an6.61:10.5: sabbesaṃ vo bhikkhave subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena, api ca yaṃ mayā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ pārāyane mettayyapañhe:
an6.61:12.2: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ,
an6.61:12.4: phasso kho bhikkhave eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto. phassanirodho majjhe. taṇhā sibbanī.
an6.61:12.5: taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tasseva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.
an6.61:12.6: ettāvatā kho bhikkhave bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti. abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassa antakaro hotī’ti.
